stage: implementation and exhaustive toy correctness; no attack performance claim
curve: y^2 + x*y = x^3 + 1 over GF(2^n), existing type-II ONB
domain: finite target; nonzero factor abscissas; factor abscissas pairwise distinct and different from target abscissa
sat_solver: pycryptosat; one thread; exact version captured at execution
sat_comparison: enumerate and block projected x-tuples; independently lift all signs and sum points; compare complete sets with brute-force oracle

annihilator_panel.search: all a and all nonzero b; c fixed by f(-R)=0

annihilator_domain: same distinct nonzero factor abscissas; V is span of the first d ONB vectors; H divides L_V; H(0) and H(x_R) nonzero
correctness_target: zero missing or invalid projected decompositions in every completed comparison; independent curve/group verification of every admitted RR certificate
failure_policy: any RR false acceptance or missing decomposition fails implementation validation; watchdog/exception is incomplete infrastructure evidence, not mathematical UNSAT

boundary.counting: with B signed affine factor-base points, at most binomial(B,3) distinct-point unordered triples, hence at most that many supported targets; uniform target success probability <= min(1, binomial(B,3)/group_order)
boundary.fixed_domain: a representation change cannot increase the exact supported-target set
boundary.reference: exhaustive group-law oracle for correctness; matched chained S3 for representation diagnostics
boundary.full_dlp_reference: Pollard rho; not run in this implementation-only stage
boundary.normalization: S=all attack operations/sqrt(subgroup_order) and ratios to rho remain null until relation collection, verification, rank, linear algebra and descent are all priced

metric_limits: IR circuit evaluation count and clause count are not SAT search work; field-operation categories have no unmeasured conversion to curve additions; no exponent fit or rho ratio
next_performance_gate: on a separately frozen matched workload, total verified-relation cost including setup and unsuccessful targets <= 0.8 times the best Semaev baseline on at least three increasing sizes; this is an engineering target, not a generic-group lower-bound claim
required_artifacts: raw JSON outputs with source hashes and environment
